correctness.rationale: K has strict spectral radius below 1 by boundary propagation of any hypothetical unimodular eigenvector. The explicit real block kernel satisfies the exact matrix Lyapunov equation in the exhaustive parity/position-gap cases (zero, two, and all larger even gaps); symmetry handles reversed gaps and forbidden boundary outputs are zero by explicit factors. Thus the infinite survival sum equals Q and the claim follows by its onsite block. An exact SymPy polynomial checker expands all uniform interior cases and 27 rational-boundary instances; independent direct simulations corroborate the first moment. No finite test is used as an all-size proof.

value.rationale: The expected detection time, rather than just eventual exit probability, is the natural experimental resource cost of monitored transport. The result supplies a complete exact all-site and all-coin benchmark, identifies surprising midpoint coin-independence, and exposes a Hadamard N^2 mean despite ballistic unmonitored spread. The closed-form quadratic kernel is more than a finite numerical fit or a narrow arbitrary parameter computation.
